annotations.title: Check FBAR, Form 8938 and Form 3520 thresholds

description: Checks a U.S. person's foreign-asset figures against the filing thresholds for FBAR (FinCEN Form 114), Form 8938 (FATCA) and Form 3520 (gifts or bequests from a foreign individual or estate). Only the forms whose figures are given are checked. Thresholds only: it does not decide which accounts or assets count; the descriptions of each input say what to include.

foreign_accounts_max_aggregate.description: FBAR: the highest combined value of all foreign financial accounts at any time in the year, USD.

foreign_gifts_received.description: Form 3520: total gifts and bequests received in the year from nonresident alien individuals or foreign estates, USD.

lives_abroad.description: Form 8938: true if the taxpayer meets the bona fide residence or physical presence test abroad (higher thresholds).

specified_foreign_assets_max.description: Form 8938: the highest value of specified foreign financial assets at any time in the year, USD.

specified_foreign_assets_year_end.description: Form 8938: value of specified foreign financial assets on the last day of the year, USD.

name: check_foreign_reporting_requirements
title: Check FBAR, Form 8938 and Form 3520 thresholds
